blocks.prompt: 3 (i) Find the sum to \(n\) terms of the series whose \(n\)th term is: \(3n^2 + n + 1\)
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein \(n\)th term ka formula pehle se diya hua hai, is liye \(T_k\) dhoondhne ka kaam nahi.
Bas ek baat: \(n\) ab terms ki ginti ke liye chahiye, is liye general term mein \(n\) ki jagah \(k\) likhenge.
Plan: \(S_n = \sum T_k\) ko sigmas mein toro, formulas lagao, common factor nikalo aur chhote \(n\) se check karo.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(n\)th term \(= 3n^2 + n + 1\)
Humein find karna hai: \(S_n\).
Tareeqa: \(k\)th term \(T_k\) ko \(k\) ki powers mein likhenge, phir \(S_n = \sum T_k\) ko alag alag sigmas mein tor kar yeh formulas lagayenge: \(\sum 1 = n\), \(\sum k = \frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\), \(\sum k^2 = \frac{n(n + 1)(2n + 1)}{6}\), \(\sum k^3 = \left[\frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\right]^2\) (sab sums \(k = 1\) se \(n\) tak). Book ki properties of summation: jama ka sigma sigmas ka jama hota hai, aur constant sigma ke bahar aa jata hai.

\(k\)th term likhein
\[T_k = 3k^2 + k + 1\]
Kyun: \(n\) ki jagah \(k\) likha, kyunke \(n\) ab yeh batayega ke kitne terms jama karne hain. Ek hi letter do kaam kare to ghalti hoti hai.

Sigma formulas se \(n\) terms jama karein
\[S_n = 3\sum k^2 + \sum k + \sum 1\]
\[= \dfrac{n(n + 1)(2n + 1)}{2} + \dfrac{n(n + 1)}{2} + n\]
Kyun: Teen sigmas: squares wale mein 3 aur 6 se \(\frac{1}{2}\) bana, \(\sum k\) seedha, aur \(\sum 1 = n\).

Common factor nikal kar saada karein
\[= \dfrac{n}{2}\left[(n + 1)(2n + 1) + (n + 1) + 2\right]\]
\[= \dfrac{n}{2}(2n^2 + 4n + 4)\]
\[= n(n^2 + 2n + 2)\]
Kyun: \(\frac{n}{2}\) bahar nikala; aakhri \(n\) se andar 2 bacha kyunke \(n = \frac{n}{2} \times 2\). Kholkar \(2n^2 + 3n + 1 + n + 1 + 2 = 2n^2 + 4n + 4\), phir is se 2 nikal kar bahar ke 2 se cancel kiya.

Chhote \(n\) se tasdeeq
\[n = 2:\ 5 + 15 = 20\]
\[2(4 + 4 + 2) = 20 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Formula ko parakhne ka sab se pakka tareeqa: chhote \(n\) par series ke terms seedha jama karein aur formula se milayein. Dono barabar hain, is liye jawab sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 3 (ii) Find the sum to \(n\) terms of the series whose \(n\)th term is: \(n^2 + 4n + 1\)
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein \(n\)th term ka formula pehle se diya hua hai, is liye \(T_k\) dhoondhne ka kaam nahi.
Bas ek baat: \(n\) ab terms ki ginti ke liye chahiye, is liye general term mein \(n\) ki jagah \(k\) likhenge.
Plan: \(S_n = \sum T_k\) ko sigmas mein toro, formulas lagao, common factor nikalo aur chhote \(n\) se check karo.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(n\)th term \(= n^2 + 4n + 1\)
Humein find karna hai: \(S_n\).
Tareeqa: \(k\)th term \(T_k\) ko \(k\) ki powers mein likhenge, phir \(S_n = \sum T_k\) ko alag alag sigmas mein tor kar yeh formulas lagayenge: \(\sum 1 = n\), \(\sum k = \frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\), \(\sum k^2 = \frac{n(n + 1)(2n + 1)}{6}\), \(\sum k^3 = \left[\frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\right]^2\) (sab sums \(k = 1\) se \(n\) tak). Book ki properties of summation: jama ka sigma sigmas ka jama hota hai, aur constant sigma ke bahar aa jata hai.

\(k\)th term likhein
\[T_k = k^2 + 4k + 1\]
Kyun: \(n\) ki jagah \(k\) likha, kyunke \(n\) ab yeh batayega ke kitne terms jama karne hain. Ek hi letter do kaam kare to ghalti hoti hai.

Sigma formulas se \(n\) terms jama karein
\[S_n = \sum k^2 + 4\sum k + \sum 1\]
\[= \dfrac{n(n + 1)(2n + 1)}{6} + 2n(n + 1) + n\]
Kyun: Teen sigmas; \(\sum k\) wale mein 4 aur 2 se \(2n(n + 1)\) bana, aur \(\sum 1 = n\).

Common factor nikal kar saada karein
\[= \dfrac{n}{6}\left[(n + 1)(2n + 1) + 12(n + 1) + 6\right]\]
\[= \dfrac{n}{6}(2n^2 + 3n + 1 + 12n + 18)\]
\[= \dfrac{n}{6}(2n^2 + 15n + 19)\]
Kyun: Common denominator 6 hai, is liye \(\frac{n}{6}\) nikala: \(2n(n + 1) \to 12(n + 1)\), \(n \to 6\). Like terms: \(3n + 12n = 15n\), \(1 + 12 + 6 = 19\).
Dhyan dein: book mein \(n^2\) aur \(4n\) ke beech ka plus halka chhapa hai; answer key isi plus wali series ka jawab deti hai.

Chhote \(n\) se tasdeeq
\[n = 2:\ 6 + 13 = 19\]
\[\tfrac{2}{6}(8 + 30 + 19) = 19 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Formula ko parakhne ka sab se pakka tareeqa: chhote \(n\) par series ke terms seedha jama karein aur formula se milayein. Dono barabar hain, is liye jawab sahi hai.
